crossRefs.note: This testimony is true. For this cause, reprove them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,
preach the word; be urgent in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and exhort with all patience and teaching.
for he taught them with authority, and not like the scribes.
They were astonished at his teaching, for he taught them as having authority, and not as the scribes.

translations.web: Say these things and exhort and reprove with all authority. Let no one despise you.
translations.bsb: Speak these things as you encourage and rebuke with all authority. Let no one despise you.
translations.kjv: These things speak, and exhort, and rebuke with all authority. Let no man despise thee.
translations.asv: These things speak and exhort and reprove with all authority. Let no man despise thee.
